_what: Cloud columns the local SQLite mirror never creates, pulls or pushes while the cloud still carries them. An older local file that already has one keeps it (like retired_columns.json). Access-ladder T-13 (common-docs/projects/access-ladder/t13/PLAN.md phase 5): the row column retiring into shown_to + published_to_web; phase 7 drops it from the cloud, then it moves to retired_columns.json.
